job.name: ig18_gran_a
job.meaning: бабушка ~78, вязаный кардиган, платок на плечах, деревенская кухня, тёплый свет из окна
job.prompt: Photorealistic portrait of a kind Russian grandmother about 78 with soft white hair in a neat bun, a warm hand-knitted brown cardigan and a light floral kerchief over her shoulders. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, medium close shot from the chest up, face large and sharp, top of head about 12% below the upper edge, looking straight into the lens, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, gentle loving expression, kind eyes with smile wrinkles, NO broad smile, mouth relaxed. Natural skin texture with real wrinkles and age spots, NOT CGI, NOT a glamour retouch, NOT airbrushed. No text, no logos, no watermark. Background: a cosy village-house kitchen with lace curtains, a samovar and jars on a wooden shelf, softly blurred, warm afternoon sunlight from a window.
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary elderly person (not a celebrity), looks genuinely real and warm.
